articles.title: En Suisse, l’inculpation inédite d’un journaliste du fait d’une loi sur les banques nourrit des inquiétudes
articles.summary: Lukas Hässig, dont les articles ont permis de dévoiler un important scandale bancaire, a été inculpé à la mi-octobre. L’utilisation de la loi suisse sur les banques contre les journalistes d’investigation pourrait constituer une menace contre la liberté de la presse.

articles.title: Watch: New York teen reunites with cat missing after building collapse
articles.summary: Rescuers found the pet cat in the ruins of Zariah's apartment four days after she made an emotional plea to the public.

articles.title: COP31 : quels pays doivent régler la facture de la lutte contre la catastrophe climatique ?
articles.summary: La France a fait de l’élargissement du cercle des Etats tenus d’aider financièrement les pays en développement « une priorité » de la COP31, qui se poursuit en Turquie.

articles.title: Miguel Angel Félix Gallardo, l’un des narcotrafiquants mexicains les plus puissants, est mort après trente-sept ans passés en prison
articles.summary: Ce baron de la drogue est mort, dimanche à l’hôpital, à l’âge de 80 ans, alors qu’il purgeait des peines de soixante-dix-sept ans de prison. Il a marqué l’histoire criminelle du Mexique en posant les fondations des cartels modernes, jusqu’à inspirer la série Netflix « Narcos : Mexico ».

articles.title: En Amazonie péruvienne, Léon XIV alerte sur la déforestation et dénonce l’abandon des peuples autochtones
articles.summary: « Le cri de la terre et le cri des pauvres s’élèvent ensemble », a déclaré, dimanche, le souverain pontife, lors d’une nouvelle étape de sa tournée en Amérique latine. Il a notamment dénoncé « l’exploitation » des ressources et l’assassinat de chefs autochtones qui défendent leurs terres.

articles.title: Chris Van Hollen Says His Majority Leader Challenge to Chuck Schumer Is Gaining Support
articles.summary: Senator Chris Van Hollen of Maryland said on Sunday that he has a “wide-open” path to unseat Chuck Schumer, the long-serving Senate Democratic leader.

articles.title: Steering failure preceded New Orleans cruise ship collision, says NTSB
articles.summary: Preliminary findings by National Transportation Safety Board investigators suggest the tanker suffered a "steering casualty" before colliding with the cruise ship on Friday.

articles.title: Nvidia Fallout Looms Over Trump-Xi Meeting
articles.summary: So far, President Trump has indicated that he does not plan to press the Chinese leader about U.S. intelligence findings that a Chinese spy targeted Jensen Huang.

articles.title: 8 Takeaways From a Big Democratic Gathering in Denver: Democrats in Array
articles.summary: More than a half-dozen potential Democratic presidential candidates made early pitches for themselves and their visions at what amounted to a party-wide post-election victory party.

articles.title: Flight Delays and Cancellations Persist as System Recovers From Ground Stop
articles.summary: Operations are returning to normal after air traffic was shut down for more than 4 hours on Friday following a maintenance upgrade that crippled communications.

articles.title: Canada bars Russia from Junior World Championships
articles.summary: Canada says it will not allow Russian athletes to compete in the Junior Ice Hockey World Championships because of the war in Ukraine.

articles.title: F.D.A. Rejects Closely Watched Lung Cancer Drug From China
articles.summary: The treatment, called ivonescimab, has become a symbol of China’s rise in drug development.

articles.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
articles.summary: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

articles.title: Suspension des vols aux Etats-Unis : retour à la normale du trafic aérien espéré pour lundi ; Donald Trump qualifie la gestion de l’aviation par Joe Biden de « désastre »
articles.summary: Encore près de 2 000 vols ont été supprimés dimanche aux Etats-Unis, après que plus de 18 000 l’avaient déjà été vendredi et samedi. « Nous allons sans doute voir les choses revenir complètement à la normale lundi », a estimé le secrétaire aux transports.

articles.title: Sean Duffy Offers New Details on How One Fix Spiraled Into Nationwide Ground Stop
articles.summary: When asked, the transportation secretary could not guarantee on Sunday that a similar air traffic meltdown would not occur again.

articles.title: Une juge ordonne qu’un parc de Washington dont Donald Trump souhaite faire un golf de luxe reste ouvert
articles.summary: Le président américain souhaite réaménager le parc East Potomac pour en faire un site pouvant accueillir des compétitions de golf de très haut niveau. Son administration avait demandé la fermeture, dimanche, de cet espace vert de 160 hectares.

articles.title: Embattled Federal Employees Look to a Democratic Congress for a Lifeline
articles.summary: Former and current workers have found a sympathetic ear among Democrats set to take over the House and Senate. But any reversal of President Trump’s cuts is unlikely to happen immediately.

articles.title: Judge blocks Trump closure of 'Trash Island' Washington DC golf course on Sunday
articles.summary: The temporary order is part of a months-long challenge to the US president's plans to upgrade East Potomac Golf Links into a championship course.

articles.title: What’s Behind the Trump-Huang Relationship?
articles.summary: President Trump’s show of support for Jensen Huang as he was under fire was a remarkable moment in a relationship that barely existed two years ago. Our White House correspondent Maggie Haberman explains how Mr. Trump came to see Mr. Huang as a modern-day Henry Ford.

articles.title: Judge Blocks Immediate Closure of East Potomac Park for Trump Golf Project
articles.summary: Judge Ana C. Reyes, who has been overseeing combative litigation, said the Trump administration would not be responsible for operating the course while the case proceeded.

articles.title: Confrontée à un El Niño historique, l’Amazonie brésilienne en état d’urgence environnemental
articles.summary: L’Etat du Para et cinquante villes de l’Etat de l’Amazonas ont été placés en état d’urgence afin de mobiliser tous les moyens pour combattre les feux de forêt et venir en aide aux quelque 161 000 familles touchées.

articles.title: Lutnick Pushed to Weaken Chip Rules That Overlap With His Family Business
articles.summary: The commerce secretary has been writing new rules that would affect Southeast Asian data centers, some of which are clients of his former firm.

articles.title: After Midterms Triumph, Democrats Look Quickly and Eagerly Ahead to 2028
articles.summary: Politicians, donors and campaign strategists are already imagining a large and contentious field of presidential contenders.

articles.title: Fifth Canadian soldier dies from injuries caused by large fire at military base
articles.summary: Pte William Douglas Dal Bianco died from his injuries on Friday, a month after a fire that tore through CFB Wainwright.
